Declared world is consistent with what the image provides: instruction.md:15 'built with Node.js, Express and SQLite ... Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4 'one Node 22 process with Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages and Node built-ins'; instruction.md:11 and hireops_rules.md:212 point to /assets/seed_data.json and /instructions/*, both staged. Runtime evidence: the raw evidence index (hashes re-verified) records a scripted golden run on 8 Oct 2026 in hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair, whose image uses the same npm pins, so those package versions do install and load on Node 22 bookworm. No agent-image (environment/Dockerfile) build log is in the index; since the file is identical to the shared template and row 15 is a static content check, this is recorded as a partial-runtime note, not a missing required measurement. Adversarial: a weak app that needs another npm package (e.g. ws, socket.io) would fail to start at grade time, but that is the declared contract (integration.md 'use only those packages'), not an image defect; a conforming alternative using node:sqlite or vendoring packages under /app/node_modules (integration.md:16-19 allows that) is not harmed by the image. A golden-only dependency that the image lacks would be the failure mode; none exists.
